cause_assessments.reason: The coherent original frame records audio.choice label as “✓, Wi-Fi only” while the visible wording is complete. The frozen Android observer walks unmerged descendants and synthesizes its label by concatenating native Text (NativeObserverTest.kt lines 88–89 and 137); production source lines 199–208 clears semantics on the decorative Box. The raw strict label failure is retained. These inputs do not export the merged accessibility-service label, so they do not resolve observation aggregation versus an actual component accessibility-label defect. Host gutters and paint sampling do not explain this text discrepancy.

The original collector records “✓, Wi-Fi only” by synthesizing a label from unmerged descendant Text (NativeObserverTest.kt raw() at line 89 and label() at line 137), rather than an Android accessibility-service label. The production choice explicitly clears semantics on the decorative mark Box (OfflineAudioTourPanel.kt lines 200–205) and exposes selected separately at lines 189–191. The visible Wi-Fi only text is complete. Preserve the strict native F; this unmerged-label construction supports an observation cause and does not establish a product accessibility-label defect or a TalkBack pass.

cause_assessments.reason: The coherent original frame records audio.choice label as “✓, Wi-Fi only” while the visible wording is complete. The frozen Android observer walks unmerged descendants and synthesizes its label by concatenating native Text (NativeObserverTest.kt lines 88–89 and 137); production source lines 199–208 clears semantics on the decorative Box. The raw strict label failure is retained. These inputs do not export the merged accessibility-service label, so they do not resolve observation aggregation versus an actual component accessibility-label defect. Host gutters and paint sampling do not explain this text discrepancy.

The original collector records “✓, Wi-Fi only” by synthesizing a label from unmerged descendant Text (NativeObserverTest.kt raw() at line 89 and label() at line 137), rather than an Android accessibility-service label. The production choice explicitly clears semantics on the decorative mark Box (OfflineAudioTourPanel.kt lines 200–205) and exposes selected separately at lines 189–191. The visible Wi-Fi only text is complete. Preserve the strict native F; this unmerged-label construction supports an observation cause and does not establish a product accessibility-label defect or a TalkBack pass.

cause_assessments.reason: The coherent original frame records audio.choice label as “✓, Wi-Fi only” while the visible wording is complete. The frozen Android observer walks unmerged descendants and synthesizes its label by concatenating native Text (NativeObserverTest.kt lines 88–89 and 137); production source lines 199–208 clears semantics on the decorative Box. The raw strict label failure is retained. These inputs do not export the merged accessibility-service label, so they do not resolve observation aggregation versus an actual component accessibility-label defect. Host gutters and paint sampling do not explain this text discrepancy.

The original collector records “✓, Wi-Fi only” by synthesizing a label from unmerged descendant Text (NativeObserverTest.kt raw() at line 89 and label() at line 137), rather than an Android accessibility-service label. The production choice explicitly clears semantics on the decorative mark Box (OfflineAudioTourPanel.kt lines 200–205) and exposes selected separately at lines 189–191. The visible Wi-Fi only text is complete. Preserve the strict native F; this unmerged-label construction supports an observation cause and does not establish a product accessibility-label defect or a TalkBack pass.

The raw strict label failure is retained. These inputs do not export the merged accessibility-service label, so they do not resolve observation aggregation versus an actual component accessibility-label defect. Host gutters and paint sampling do not explain this text discrepancy.

The production choice explicitly clears semantics on the decorative mark Box (OfflineAudioTourPanel.kt lines 200–205) and exposes selected separately at lines 189–191. cause_assessments.reason: The coherent original frame records audio.choice label as “✓, Wi-Fi only” while the visible wording is complete. The frozen Android observer walks unmerged descendants and synthesizes its label by concatenating native Text (NativeObserverTest.kt lines 88–89 and 137); production source lines 199–208 clears semantics on the decorative Box. The raw strict label failure is retained. These inputs do not export the merged accessibility-service label, so they do not resolve observation aggregation versus an actual component accessibility-label defect. Host gutters and paint sampling do not explain this text discrepancy.

The original collector records “✓, Wi-Fi only” by synthesizing a label from unmerged descendant Text (NativeObserverTest.kt raw() at line 89 and label() at line 137), rather than an Android accessibility-service label. The production choice explicitly clears semantics on the decorative mark Box (OfflineAudioTourPanel.kt lines 200–205) and exposes selected separately at lines 189–191. The visible Wi-Fi only text is complete. Preserve the strict native F; this unmerged-label construction supports an observation cause and does not establish a product accessibility-label defect or a TalkBack pass.

source_datum.value: The sound of craft: a walk through the textile galleries
Begin beside the spinning wheel and examine the worn treadle. A weaver describes learning to keep the thread steady while watching the changing bundle of fiber.
At the fiber cabinet, compare the wool and flax samples. This chapter explains how their different textures influenced the cloth a workshop could make.
Listen beside the dye pots to learn how plants produced familiar colors. Look for the small sample cards that record each workshop recipe.
Stand near the large loom and follow the line of its threads. The narrator describes preparing a pattern before the first row of cloth was woven.
The pattern books preserve ideas passed between makers. Pause at the open page while a designer explains adapting a familiar motif for a new commission.
At the mending table, listen to a repairer describe choosing a patch. The nearby coat shows how careful work can preserve a garment for another generation.
The market display follows a finished bolt from workshop to customer. Short memories describe measuring, bargaining, and choosing fabric for a special family occasion.
Finish beside the contemporary textiles. The closing voices describe the tools they still use and invite you to compare their work with the older cloth nearby.

Begin beside the spinning wheel and examine the worn treadle. A weaver describes learning to keep the thread steady while watching the changing bundle of fiber.
At the fiber cabinet, compare the wool and flax samples. This chapter explains how their different textures influenced the cloth a workshop could make.
Listen beside the dye pots to learn how plants produced familiar colors. Look for the small sample cards that record each workshop recipe.
Stand near the large loom and follow the line of its threads. The narrator describes preparing a pattern before the first row of cloth was woven.
The pattern books preserve ideas passed between makers. Pause at the open page while a designer explains adapting a familiar motif for a new commission.
At the mending table, listen to a repairer describe choosing a patch. The nearby coat shows how careful work can preserve a garment for another generation.
The market display follows a finished bolt from workshop to customer. Short memories describe measuring, bargaining, and choosing fabric for a special family occasion.
Finish beside the contemporary textiles. The closing voices describe the tools they still use and invite you to compare their work with the older cloth nearby.
